༄༅/ /dpal gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo bla med kyi sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo bla med kyi sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā stī/ dpal gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan srid zhi'i lam gnyis mngon bcom nas/ / 'gyur med bde ba'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor las/ /dpag yas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshogs spro ba/ /mi g.yo mgon pos srid 'di skyong bar mdzod/ /gang gi gnyis med ye shes ni/ / gdod ma'i mgon po mi g.yo ba/ /ma bcos rim pa mngon gyur phyir/ /bcos ma'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs mtshar/ / 'dir dpal gtum po khro bo'i rgyud mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med par yongs su grags pa'i rim pa las 'ongs pa lha dgu'i bdag nyid kyi bskyed rim bsgom par 'dod pas/ mchod pa la sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ /bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i sgom bzlas rnams kyang ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ / de nas legs par sbyangs pa'i maṇḍal la dri bzang gi thig le bkod/ mdun du mchod pa bshams/ thal mo sbyar te/ khro bo gtum po khros pa'i mig can ral gri g.yas pa'i phyag mdzes shing*/ zhags par bcas pa'i khu tshur sdig mdzub bsgreng bar bcas pa gzhan pa'i phyag gis te/ pus mo sa la gtod pa'i sku ni nges par sprin nag dang 'dra ba/ bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad mgon po mi g.yo khyod kyis srid 'di'i bgegs zhi mdzod/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badzra satwā haṃ/ rang nyid mi g.yo bar gyur/ lag pa gnyis su zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig re re/ badzra padma ha sto3haṃ/ lag pa g.yas ral gri'i phyag rgya byas la/ snying ga dpral ba spyi bo rnams su reg cing*/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri khiṃ hūṃ/ phrag pa la sogs pa rnams su reg cing*/ phrag pa g.yas su ya mān ta kri ta hūṃ/ g.yon du pradzñānta kri ta hūṃ/ khar padmanta kri ta hūṃ/ gsang bar bi ghāntan kri ta hūṃ/

oṃ hūṃ swāhā badzraṃ/ rdo rje blangs/ oṃ āḥswāhā ghanṭaṃ dril bu blangs/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ dril bu snying gar lan brgyad dkrol/ oṃ āḥtsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyi bsang chu byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥbi ghnā nu ta sā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gnas dang yo byad la bsang chu gtor/ oṃ ā badzra puṣpe hūṃ/ sogs kyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ thod pa'i nang du dam rdzas rnams hūṃ dang maṃ las byung ba'i mi bskyod pa yab yum du gyur/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes bdud rtsir bzhu/ oṃ sarba bhakṣa kā mi ni bhakṣa sho dha ni gu hya badzri ṇi kro dhe shwa ri sarba dra byaṃ bya bi ni shwa dha ya shwa dha ya hūṃ/ oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ taṃ pra we sha ya hūṃ/ zhes nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ ral gri'i phyag rgya bsnun stabs su byas la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa sarba pā sa notatstsha ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa kyis bgegs bskrad/ phyag rgya de nyid g.yas su bskor/ oṃ shrī tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa rakṣa rakṣa maṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ/ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bidya ra dzā hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes gnas gsum du me tog reg oṃ āḥbadzra sa ne hūṃ/ sa la dor/ gdong la'ang sngags des dor/ maṇḍal la dri bzang byugs tshul bya/ oṃ ā tiṣṭha badzra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra bhu mi hūṃ/ maṇḍal 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i gzhal med khang du gyur/ hūṃ lan dgu dri'i thig le'i gnas su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dgur gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i gtum po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma ha ro ṣa ṇa sa pā ri wā ra sa hi ta ā gatstsha ā gatstsha dzaḥhūṃ zhes maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par bsams/ baṃ zhes pas rang gi gdan la zhen zhing bzhugs/

ho zhes pas bdag la dgyes te dngos grub stsaul ba'i phyir de 'phangs mtho bar bzhugs par bsam/ a tra manṭa le a dhi ṣṭhā na ku ru phaṭa swāhā/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ shrī tsa ṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa bhanṭa ra ka sa pa ri wā re pra wa ra satkā rā ya pādyaṃ pra ti tstsha swāhā/ añtsa ma naṃ/ bro kṣa naṃ/ arghaṃ rnams kyis chu bzhi phul/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta su la li ta na mi ta na ma tai bha ga wantaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥku su ma añdza li nā tha hoḥ zhes me tog gtor/ oṃ kra ṣṇi a tsa la puṣpe pra tītstsha hūṃ phaṭa de bzhin du/ shwe te a tsa la/ bi ta a tsa la/ rakha a tsa la/ shyā saṃ a tsa la/ de ṣa badzri ṇī/ mo ha badzri ṇī/ pi shuu ṇa badzri nā ི / ra ga badzri ṇī/ īrṣ+ya badzri ṇī/ zhes pa rnams 'don pa spos nas so sor me tog phul/ de bzhin du/ nai wedya bar du phul/ oṃ badzra sa tu su saṃ gra ha ta/ badzra ratna ma nutta raṃ/ badzra dharma gā ya nī/ badzra karma ka rod bha we/ khyab 'jug phyi mar 'thag par byed cing bdud kyi khengs pa rab bcil dbang phyug kyang ni 'joms/ / tshangs pa'i sgo ra dum bur mdzad de sa chu byin za rlung gi khams rnams nyams byed pa/ /'jigs byed ri rab gza' tshogs bcas pa'i mtho ris sa steng sa 'og skyong dang phyogs skyong klu/ /'jig rten gsum gnon rnam rgyal sku can dpal ldan mi g.yo gtum chen khro bo rgyal gyur cig so sor mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor zhing*/ oṃ kṛ ṣṇa a tsa la na maḥ de bzhin du/ shwe ta a tsa la sogs/ irṣ+ya badzri ṇi'i bar du so so'i mtshan spel la 'bul/ lha rnams yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud gang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ spro na skabs 'dir 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtor ma dang*/ cha gsum nas 'byung ba ltar phyogs skyong bcu'i gtor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams kyang 'bul lo/

/rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod mdzad rigs/ /tshul khrims tsandan lus la byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ni gos gyon te/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar zhugs su gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor thams cad bdag nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ mngon rtogs mdor bsdus su sgom pa'i tshe/ oṃ āḥtiṣṭha badzra/ man chad maṇḍal gyi mchod pa 'di bor la/ bsod nams tshogs gsog spyi dang mthun pa zhig byas pas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas tshad med bzhi sgoms la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i me lces bdag lus khams gsum snod bcud dang bcas pa cig car bsregs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bar do'i rnam shes sgyu ma lta bu'i lus dkar po mtshan dpes spras pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi shes rab mas 'khyud cing*/ pad dkar dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa steng gi nam mkha' la 'khor bar gyur/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa lcog brgyad dang ldan pa/ gser gyi ri bdun rol pa' ི mtsho bdun gling bcu gnyis rgya mtsho chen po khor yug dang bcas pa/ ri rab kyi rtse mor e las chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir gur mi bya ེda cing bstan pa phyi rol ye shes kyi me dpung drag tu 'bar bas bskor ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ bhruṃ ser po las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/

rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang*/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang*/ pha gu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab kyi mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun na ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs/ snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o// gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser*/ nub dmar/ byang ljang dbus sngo ba/ 'phar ma gcig dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dgu /de rnams kyi steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dgu dbus kyi gdan gyis steng du hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i yum mā ma kī la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu'i sgras/ rang nyid bar do'i rnam shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de nyid nā da'i rnam par gyur te skar mda' 'pho ba ltar yab kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su bzhu ste lha mo'i padmar spros pa hūṃ mthing kar gyur/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad zhe sdang rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ hūṃ la thim pa las rang nyid mi g.yo ba nag po gtum po khro bo'i skur gyur te/ yum gyi mkha'i g.yas phyogs kyi mtha' las phyir phyung*/ oṃ kṛṣṇa a tsa la huṃ phaṭa/ rang nyid mi g.yo ba zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa la rdo rje ral gris brdegs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu/ mā ma kī dang lhan cig bdud rtsi de nyid gsol bas tshim zhing dgyes pa chen pos rjes chags kyi gdung bas yongs su 'khyud pa las/ mā ma kī zhe sdang rdo rje ma'i rnam par 'gyur/ oṃ de ṣa badzri hūṃ phaṭa/

dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag gnyis gtso bo yab yum gyi skur gyur pa ni mthing ka inṭa nī la'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i sku brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ 'phreng bag chags shir grims pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ches cher khros pa/ rab tu gtum pas khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ shin tu rno bas mche ba dang bcas pa/ ya sos ma mchu'i sgros mnan pa/ steng 'og tu phyogs par yo ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi spyan gnyis dang spyan dbus ma thad kar gzigs pa ste gsum ka'ang dmar zhingazlum pa/ zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub 'og tu nor 'dzin ma la gtod pa/ zhabs g.yas pa gyen du 'degs shing brdabs pas bdud bzhi'i rang bzhin tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag po rnams skrag par mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon gyi pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yon ngos su 'gying bag dang bcas te me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / zhabs g.yas g.yon go bzlog kyang rung ngo*/ / de la 'khyud pa'i yum zhe sdang rdo rje ma lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can lang tsho la babs shing nu ma rgyas pa phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa dbu skra ltag par phyed bcings su byas pa byin pa gnyis kyis dgyes par 'khril ba'i sku can bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'i shes rab ma ste/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan 'og pag gdu bu do shal do shal phyed pa rkang gdub kyi g.yer kha la sogs pas nye bar brgyan pa/ bde ba chen po dang stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i ngo bor dag pa'o/ / shes rab kyi mkha' a las padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ bandhuka lta bu'i rdul gyis mtshan pa'i ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ thabs kyi bsang ba hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa nor bu la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/

lha mo'i spyi bor oṃ āḥhuṃ/ rjes chags kyi rol pa chen po dang bcas pas snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ yab kyi spyi bo nas zhugs byang chub kyi sems a wa dhu tī'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa las thig le'i gong bu brgyad du gyur/ de rnams hūṃ yig brgyad du gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad rigs bzhi yab yum gyi go 'phangs la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pa las lha brgyad du gyur/ yab rnams yum gyi bha ga'i g.yas kyi mtha' dang yum rnams g.yon gyi mtha' nas spros/ oṃ shwe ta a tsa la hūṃ phaṭa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa shar gyi gdan gyi steng du 'khod/ oṃ ma hā badzri hūṃ phaṭa/ gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa shar lho'i gdan la 'khod/ oṃ bī ta a tsa la hūṃ phaṭa/ mig g.yo ba ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa lho'i gdan la 'khod/ oṃ bī shu na badzri hūṃ phaṭa/ phra ma rdo rje ma ser mo rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa lho nub kyi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ rakta a tsa la hūṃ phaṭa/ mi g.yo ba dmar po padma'i mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa nub kyi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ rā ga badzri hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo padmas mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa nub byang gi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ shyā ma a tsa la hūṃ phaṭa/ mi g.yo ba ljang khu sna tshogs udpa las mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa byang gi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ irṣa badzri hūṃ phaṭa/ phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu udpa las mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa byang shar gyi gdan la 'khod/ khro bo bzhi po ni bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ 'on kyang g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub gyen du bsgreng pa'o/ / lha mo bzhi po ni bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs te 'on kyangaphyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/

g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis rim pas gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi mthil dang g.yon gyi pus mo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gtad pa'o/ /de nas gtso bo yab yum rjes su chags pa'i bde ba chen po 'dod chags chen po'i dam tshig gi sbyor ba las byang chub sems su zhu bar gyur/ de nas lha mo bzhis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/ gti mug rdo rje mas/ khyab bdag byams pa rnams spangs nas/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin du ma mdzad/ khyod dang rnam bral bdag 'gum pas/ /'gro kun stong par ma mdzad cig phra ma rdo rje mas/ snying rje'i sems bral bdag 'gum pas/ /khyab bdag stong par ma mdzad cig /bdag gi lus 'di sdug bsngal bas/ /'tsho ba dang bral ci ste mdzad/ 'dod chags rdo rje mas/ ci ste mkhas pa khyod kyi ni/ /dga' ba spangs nas stong par 'jug /'jig rten ma lus pa rnams dang*/ /bdag gi yid ni khyod la gtad/ phrag dog rdo rje mas/ lang tsho dang ldan btang snyoms pa'i/ / mig ni stong pa 'bras med can/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spong la/ /bdag la mnyam nyid sbyor ba mdzod/ ces pa'i glu sgra snyan lta bu'i yongs su sad de/ thig le las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das yan lag ma dang bcas pa sngon bzhin du grub par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' gtum po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ puṣpe

sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa pā ri wā rā sa hi ta ā gatstsha ā gatstsha dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ a tra maṇḍal adhaṣṭhā naṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga tā/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas lha thams cad kyi sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ shar dang shar lho pa la rnam snang lho dang lho nub pa la rin 'byung nub dang nub byang pa la 'od dpag med byang dang byang shar pa la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ rangagi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lha mo brgyad dang bcas pas mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs la so so'i sngags ( dzaṃ + re'i mthar 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod 'bul ) kyis sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis gtso bo la bstod par bsams la/ 'od 'phro gtum pa'i spyan dang 'jigs rung khro gnyer dang ldan tshems kyis ma mchu mnan/ g.yon pa'i pus mo sa la rnam bkod gzhan pa'i zhabs kyis gdul dka'i bdud rnams gnon/ srid gsum 'jigs 'phrog mchog gis ral gri'i phyag dang khu tshur sdigs mdzub zhags pa can/ rtag par inṭa nī la ltar 'bar gtum chen khro bo mi g.yo rgyal gyur cig zhes bstod par bya'o/ /de nas rlung kha sbyor drag tu bzung la/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i sgo nas gti mug rdo rje mi g.yo ba dkar po la rdo rje ral gris sdigs pas 'od kyi phung por gyur nas bdag la thim/

rang nyid mi g.yo ba dkar po'i gzugs su gyur nas gti mug rdo rje ma dang lhan cig 'dod chags chen po'i dam tshig gi sbyor ba la gnas par bsams/ slar yang rang snang gi ye shes las grub pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po dang gti mug rdo rje ma shar dang shar lhor sngar bzhin 'khod/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i gzugs kyi dbus su gnas par bsams/ de bzhin du rigs lhag ma gsum la'ang sbyar/ de ltar na zla ba gcig nyid kyi gzugs brnyan du ma chu dang me long sogs la 'char ba bzhin du/ rang nyid dpa' bo gcig pu'i rang bzhin lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du 'char ba snang la rang bzhin med pa la mnyam par bzhag de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ sgom pa'i rim pa dag pa dang bcas pa rgyas par rgyud kyi rgyal po nyid las 'byung ba de nyid ji lta ba bzhin brjod pa'am/ phyag len la mdo tsam brjod par mdzad pa ni/ gru bzhi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi ste/ /sgo bzhi bden pa bzhi po'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi rta babs dang*/ /'phags lam brgyad kyi ka ba rnams/ /sems rtse gcig pas 'phar ma dang*/ /padma skye gnas dag pa nyid/ / sprul pa kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /gnas ni gsung rab yan lag dgu /'dod chags chen pos phyogs dmar po/ /rigs bzhi dbye bas mtshams rnams ni/ /ser dang ljang ser nag po ste/ /nyi zla khu khrag dag pa'o/ /gzugs sogs phung po lnga po ni/ /'gyur med ye shes lnga dag pa/ /gtum chen lnga ste khams lnga po/ /stong pa lnga dag yum rnams so/ /shes rab thabs dngos ral gri zhags/ /dbyer med rdo rje sdigs mdzub ste/ /tshangs dang sa 'og skyong ba'i phyag/ steng dang 'og tu 'phyar zhing gtod/ /zhabs stabs bdud bzhi rnams nyed pa/ / gzhon nu ma yi bde ba la/ /dgyes spyod zhabs gzhan 'dzin mar gtod/ /de phyir rdo rje byang chub 'di'o/ / ston pa rgyal ba gcig pu nyid/ /lnga yi tshul gyis yang dag gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gcig pu'ang*/

/rnam lnga'i tshul gyis yang dag gnas/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ de las sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba'i tshul spyi dang 'dra bar bsgoms nas/ oṃ tsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba gsang sngags yi ge bcu po 'di nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ oṃ a tsa la hūṃ haṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes pa rnams kyang snying po'o/ /rgyud las 'phreng ba'i sngags gzhan yang gsungs mod/ phyag len la 'di kho na bzla bar mdzad/ oṃ hram̐ hram̐ hrauṃ tsaṇḍa rū pe tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ pra tsa ṭa pra tsa ṭa/ ka ha ka ha/ pra phu ra pra phu ra/ pra phā ra ya pra phā ra ya/ ha na ha na/ gra sa gra sa/ bandha bandha/ dzambha ya dzambha ya/ stambha ya stambha ya/ mo hā ya mo hā ya/ sarba sha trū nāṃ/ mu kha bandha nāṃ/ ku ru ku ru/ sarba ṭā ki nī nāṃ/ gra ha bhu ta/ pi shā tsa bya dhi/ yakṣa ṇāṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya / ma ra ma ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ru ru tsaṇḍa/ tsaṇḍa ru ka rakṣa rakṣa/ lha sbyin la tsaṇḍa ma hā se naḥ sarbaṃ ā dzña pa ya ti/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ na maḥsarba a sha pa ri pū ra ke bhyoḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bhyaḥ sarba traṭa a mo gha tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa spho ṭa ya hūṃ/bhra ma ya bhra ma ya hūṃ/ traṭa mo haṃ/ zhes pa ni mi g.yo ba rigs lnga spyi'i sngags so/ / oṃ badzra yo gi nī hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pradzñā pa ra mi tā hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bau he ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum ni yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā warngha ni dzwa la dzwa la me wardha ni/dhi ri dhi ri burnghi wardha ni swāhā/ zhes pa ni yum gyi rtsa sngags dang 'phreng ba byin gyis rlabs pa'i sngags kyang yin no/ /gong du bshad pa'i so so'i mngal 'byin gyi sngags rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de nas mthar dkyil 'khor bsdu bar 'dod na/

rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ dang sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros te/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du byas/ de rnams 'od du zhu sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim phyogs kyi dpa' bo bzhi po bdag nyid la thim lha mo bzhi po'ang yum la thim ste yab yum rjes chags kyi bde ba chen pos rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'od gsal du skad cig gis thim par gyur/ de las rang nyid dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam par gyur pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngos nas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ kha zas bzang dgu las byas pa'i gtor ma/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/ nang mchod sogs 'dus byas/ manḍal mchod pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin a mṛ ta dang bsang chus sbyangs/ mchod pa rnams kyang sngags tsam gyis byin gyis rlabs/ de nas oṃ swa bha wā shudha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyis steng du/ a las padma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bhruṃ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ hūṃ las sha lnga/ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga rnams rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu ba'i rlangs pa du ba ltar 'khrigs pa'i dbus su oṃ las ral gri'i rtse mo thur du bstan pa steng du hūṃ yig dang bcas pa/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thams cad dang 'jig rten khams kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yig ral gri dang bcas pa lhungs nas rdzas rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po yongs su chad pa med par 'gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gtum po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

oṃ tsaṇḍa nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar gong bzhin/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shrī tsanṭa ma hā ro ṣa ṇā ya de wa a su ra ma nu ṣt+ya drā sa nā ya/ sam bha ma ra sa la bi nā sha nā ya/ ratna mu ku ṭa kri ta si ra se/ i maṃ ba ling gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sarba bi ghnāṃ ha ra ha ra/ tsa turmā ra na/ ni bā ra ya/ trā sa trā sa/ bhra ma bhra ma/ tstshindha tstshindha/ bhindha bindha/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ta pa ta pa/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tstshe da tstshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ duṣtaṃ sa twaṃ mā ma bi ruddha tsitta kt+ran/ bharmiṃ ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun la sogs pas phul/ chu bzhin sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ badzra lā sye hūṃ / oṃ badzra mā le traṃ/ oṃ badzra gri rti hriḥ oṃ badzra nri rti āḥ oṃ badzra dhu pe hūṃ / oṃ badzra puṣpe traṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hriḥ oṃ badzra gandhe ā ཿ kyai mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol zha ི nga*/ / srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rjes mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ gong bzhin nang mchod 'bul/ dngos grub blangs la yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ phyogs skyong bcu dang mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma'ang phul la/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa'i bar du byas nas/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ sogs dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /mchod 'os lha dang tshangs pa sogs/ /'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'dis/ /bya ba nongs nams bzod par mdzod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bdag nyid la thim se gol phyir gtogs cing*/

oṃ gatstsha gatstsha swa bhā wa nāṃ/ zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams dgyes pa dang bcas te rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ thun mtshams thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral par spyod cing*/ de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa dang bzlas brjod la brtson pas de thams cad kyang spros med kyi ye shes mchod la reg pa'i phyir 'di nyid rgyud las 'byung ba'i rim pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par bya ste/ rim gnyis kyi ye shes brtan pa na rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas 'bras bu mchog la sbyar bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang ye shes kyi stobs rnyed nas rang gzhan gyi don du 'phrin las rab 'byams rnams kyang sgrub par bya'o/ /ma lus bdun sde klad pa 'gems byed pa/ / gang 'di srid gsum g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /bla med rgyal thabs mchog gyur deng 'dir spel// srid las rgyal 'dod rnams kyis 'di long shig /'dir 'bad dge bas mtha' dag 'gro 'di yi/ / 'ching ba gcod byed de yi snying rje che/ /byang chub mchog la myur bar 'dren mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan gtum po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /dpal ldan gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ sems can mang po la phan par mthong nas rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nye bar sbyar nas bskul ba po dang yi ge pa ni sde snod 'dzin pa shākya bstan 'dzin no// // maṅga laṃ// zhus dag / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo bla med kyi sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 14--PAGE 15--PAGE 1-
